context.passage:
Marvin Gartner (7:31 A.M.)
Hi, Simone and Julio. I'm picking up food for this morning's breakfast meeting. I got everything on the list except that special milk some people requested. Do you remember which kind? I should have written it down.

Simone Bonny (7:33 A.M.)
Whole milk and nonfat. A liter of each should be enough.

Marvin Gartner (7:34 A.M.)
I've got those. But some people prefer lactose-free milk. Was it soy milk? Oat milk? They have so many kinds here.

Julio Jimenez (7:40 A.M.)
Get almond milk. That was the consensus when I polled the team last week.

Simone Bonny (7:41 A.M.)
Never tried it. Do they have it, Marvin?

Julio Jimenez (7:42 A.M.)
It's tasty, low in fat, and high in protein.

Marvin Gartner (7:45 A.M.)
It's right here. Need anything else?

Simone Bonny (7:46 A.M.)
No. See you both at 8:30!
context.passage_translation:
Marvin Gartner（上午7:31）
嗨，Simone、Julio。我正在为今天早上的早餐会议取餐。清单上的东西我都买到了，只有一些人特别要求的那种牛奶还没买。你们记得是哪一种吗？我本来应该把它记下来的。

Simone Bonny（上午7:33）
全脂牛奶和脱脂牛奶。每种一升应该就够了。

Marvin Gartner（上午7:34）
这两种我已经买了。但有些人喜欢不含乳糖的奶。是豆奶吗？燕麦奶吗？这里的种类太多了。

Julio Jimenez（上午7:40）
买杏仁奶。上周我调查团队成员的意见时，大家一致选择了这个。

Simone Bonny（上午7:41）
从没喝过。Marvin，那里有卖吗？

Julio Jimenez（上午7:42）
它很好喝，脂肪含量低，而且蛋白质含量高。

Marvin Gartner（上午7:45）
就在这儿。还需要别的吗？

Simone Bonny（上午7:46）
不用了。8:30 见！

items.question: Why does Mr. Gartner begin the text-message chain?

Because he needs to know how many people will attend an event
Because he might be late for a breakfast meeting
Because he forgot to add an item to a list
